_quick_guide: === VISION DISCOVERY TEMPLATE v1 ===  Fill this JSON during or after your first meeting with the client. Use 'not_determined' in certainty if you did not get the answer. When finished, pass it to VISION with: 'here is the discovery for client [name]' and the agent will start the project without redundant questions.

company_name._hint: Legal or commercial name of the company

business_sector._hint: E.g.: technology, healthcare, education, manufacturing, retail, logistics, legal, real estate, restaurants, financial services

value_proposition._hint: What makes the business unique? Why would a client choose them over the competition?

primary_goal._hint: Common options: generate_leads | sell_online | brand_presence | employee_portal_intranet | informational | product_catalog | other

target_audience._hint: Who visits the site? E.g.: IT directors of mid-sized companies, homemakers 25-45, university students

competitors_or_references._hint: URLs of competitor sites or sites the client likes visually. E.g.: ['https://example.com', 'https://competitor.com']

existing_website._hint: URL of current site if it exists. Empty if it is a brand new site.

pain_points._hint: What problems do they have with their current site/web presence? E.g.: ['does not generate leads', 'looks outdated', 'not responsive', 'does not appear on Google']

has_logo._hint: true if they have a logo, false if they do not

logo_format_available._hint: Available formats: SVG, PNG, AI, PSD, EPS, PDF, JPG, WEBP

hex_codes._hint: Corporate color hex codes. E.g.: ['#1a365d', '#38bdf8', '#f59e0b']. Leave empty if none.

disliked_colors._hint: Colors they do NOT want to see. E.g.: ['pink', 'bright yellow', 'neon green']

font_families._hint: Corporate typefaces. E.g.: ['Montserrat', 'Open Sans']. Leave empty if none.

has_web_license._hint: true if they have a web license for their fonts, false if unknown or they do not

style_adjectives._hint: Adjectives describing the desired visual style. E.g.: ['modern', 'sober', 'tech', 'elegant', 'minimalist', 'vibrant', 'corporate', 'luxurious']

brand_manual_available._hint: true if they have a brand manual / brand guidelines

photography_assets._hint: Options: client_provides | photo_shoot_pending | use_stock | generate_with_ai | not_determined

pages_sections._hint: List of pages or sections. E.g.: ['Home', 'Services', 'About Us', 'Blog', 'Contact', 'Store', 'FAQ', 'Gallery']

content_provider._hint: Who provides texts/copy? Options: client | external_agency | vision_generates | mixed

content_ready._hint: true if they already have ready-to-use texts, false if they need to be created

seo_priority._hint: SEO importance level: high | medium | low | not_applicable

blog_required._hint: true if the site needs a blog/news section

project_type._hint: Project type according to VISION bifurcation: landing_page | intranet_b2b | ecommerce | web_app | informational_portal

required_integrations._hint: E.g.: ['WhatsApp Business', 'Google Maps', 'payment gateway (Stripe/Conekta)', 'CRM HubSpot', 'Google Analytics', 'Meta Pixel', 'SMTP email', 'ERP', 'appointment calendar']

preferred_cms._hint: Options: next.js | wordpress | shopify | no_preference | vision_recommends

requires_auth._hint: true if it needs user login / private portal

requires_database._hint: true if it needs to store data (users, products, inventory, etc.)

requires_ecommerce._hint: true if it needs online sales with cart and checkout

domain_name._hint: Already registered domain. E.g.: 'mycompany.com'. Empty if they do not have one.

domain_registrar._hint: Where is it registered? E.g.: GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains, Akky

hosting_preference._hint: Options: aws | vercel | own_server | shared_hosting | no_preference | vision_recommends

email_service._hint: Current email service. E.g.: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, hosting email, none

decision_maker._hint: Who makes the final decision? Name and title.

deliverables_promised._hint: What did they commit to deliver? E.g.: ['logo in SVG', 'About Us text', 'team photos', 'domain access']

open_questions._hint: Questions left pending. E.g.: ['How many products do they sell?', 'Do they have a contract with current hosting?']

special_requests._hint: Special or out-of-standard requests. E.g.: ['animation in the hero', 'live chat', 'interactive price calculator']

overall_vibe._hint: Your overall impression of the client and the project in 1-2 lines. E.g.: 'Serious client, knows what they want, realistic budget. Viable project 4-6 weeks.'
